Minister Rijiju criticizes opposition rally crowd claims, AI image

Union Minister Kiren Rijiju criticized claims of a 10 lakh crowd at an opposition rally, specifically targeting an AI-generated image used to depict the gathering. Rijiju stated that the opposition could not even create a convincing fake image, implying the crowd size claims were also fabricated.
